calibration_text: It’s not that the human immune system doesn’t recognize HIV. Indeed, an infection causes the body to unleash antibodies that attack the virus, and initially some HIV is destroyed. But HIV is able to quickly defend itself by co-opting a part of the innate human immune system — the immune system people are born with, called the complement.
